dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Three prominent 'O' shaped structures and multiple 'C' shapes exhibit sharp, high-contrast pale perimeters that transition abruptly to dark, low-intensity interior regions.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low density of small, isolated punctate blobs; however, a large, contiguous concentration of solid high-intensity pixels without internal gradients occupies the right lateral region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most defined dorsal annuli form an inverted obtuse triangle relative to the animal's longitudinal axis.

other_distinctive_markers: A massive, elongated field of nearly solid white/light-grey coloration on the right lateral flank contrasts sharply with the predominantly dark and patterned dorsal fur.
